title: Got a new iPhone 18 Pro? These $5 Anker 100W USB-C cables are a must-buy
content:
Macworld

Anker 100W USB-C cables (two-pack)

View Deal

The new iPhone 18 Pro landed in stores today, and if its been a while since you upgraded, you’re going to need some new accessories. It starts with new charging cables, and these 100W Anker cables one sale at Amazon today for $10 a pair is a great place to start.

Beyond getting your phone charged in a jiffy as soon as you take it out of the box, these cables will be extremely useful around the clock. You’ll love having these cables when you’re scrolling Instagram before bed since te 6-foot length means you can toss and turn without having to worry about just how far you’ll get from the wall charger. And since you’ll have two of these cables, you can leave one plugged by your bed and at your desk all the time.

Speed is also important here. Paired with a compatible charger, each cable supports up to 100W of fast charging, which is good enough for more than just smartphones and tablets — you can also use this thing with your MacBook. One thing to note here is that this is a cable that only supports charging and data transfer, so it won’t work with an external display. If you were hoping to use one to connect a monitor to your Mac, you’ll need a different kind of cable.

For $10, this is a no-brainer if you want dependable cables that will fast charge your iPhone 18 Pro and all the other gear you own.
